job.rawJd:
21GRAMS- Senior Account Executive
Boston - Massachusetts; Carmel - Indiana; Chicago - Illinois; Lambertville - New Jersey; Remote - USA
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Account Executive to join our growing team!

21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, takes an innovative approach to advertising, and focusing on making healthcare more human. Not just in our work, but in the way we conduct business, approach client relationships, and treat each other. It’s a place where people subscribe to the adage, “Be good to each other, but hard on the work.” A place where people are not just in it for the paycheck, but to make a dent in the universe. Sound like you?

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you’ll do:

Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, understanding their needs, objectives, and expectations
Collaborate with clients and internal teams to develop comprehensive strategies that align with client goals and objectives
Manage project budgets, track expenses, and provide regular updates to clients on financial status
Anticipate risks and proactively develop plans to overcome them
Understand the implications across tactical/business plans and interdependencies between workstreams

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.
You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

What you should have:

Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Advertising, or related field
1-2 years of experience in Account Management
Strong understanding of pharmaceutical marketing regulations and guidelines (i.e., FDA regulations)
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex ideas and concepts
Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
Proficiency in Microsoft Office

Pay Range: $75,000 - $85,000

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Account Executive role at 21GRAMS. I spent eight years in healthcare and pharmaceutical agency account management, including Senior Account Executive roles at FCB Health, Barker DZP, and Cline Davis & Mann before my promotion to Account Supervisor at Scout Marketing. My work covered primary client contact, brand budgets up to $20M, financial reporting, integrated campaigns, and FDA and MLR review.

At FCB Health, I was one of two consumer account leads on the agency's largest pharmaceutical business and managed the $20M Namenda XR direct-to-consumer launch. I led the broadcast workstream for three national commercials in one year, coordinating market research, med-legal review, FDA preclearance, production, talent, locations, directors, and network clearances. The spots drove a 45% increase in new-to-brand consumers within seven weeks. Earlier, on the $10M NUVIGIL consumer business, I owned weekly client status and financial reporting, OPDP submissions, multichannel delivery, and annual strategic recommendations.

I began as the primary client contact across brand teams, affiliates, and vendors on Pfizer's Prevenar 13 adult pre-launch work. At Scout Marketing, I led Jazz Pharmaceuticals' XYREM consumer account, including its first unbranded social campaign and a digital program that doubled qualified traffic to the brand site. Since account management, I have led UX and analytics teams and built pharma agency tools for claims review, scoping, review routing, and FDA signal monitoring. That work has made me better at using data, seeing operational risk early, and keeping connected workstreams clear.

The role's focus on client needs, strategy, budgets, financial updates, and delivery risk matches work I have done directly. I would welcome the chance to discuss how that account background and the operating experience I built afterward could support the 21GRAMS team.

resume.summary: Healthcare account professional with eight years in pharmaceutical agencies, including three Senior Account Executive roles and a promotion to Account Supervisor. I served as a primary client contact, managed brand budgets up to $20M, owned financial reporting, and led regulated multichannel work through strategy, briefs, timelines, and FDA/OPDP/med-legal review. My later work in UX, analytics, and pharma workflows sharpened how I use data, spot delivery risk, and coordinate teams.
